tasks.spec:
You are a story-package engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv` (it cannot run in this sandbox), never call a billed model or the network. First run: ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv ; then use `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider <tests>` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` / `-m ruff check`. Confirm `PYTHONPATH=$PWD .venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside this worktree.

GOAL. In the story package data/stories/continuity-initiative, scenes 2A and 2B each play one scripted "incident" (see incidents.yaml: i_2a_real_leak, i_2b_audit) where the player's single command must both observe and choose. A live blind player never earns an outcome: in 2A it inspects the cooling manifold but the narration gives nothing to diagnose, so it never explains a diagnosis; in 2B it pulls its own file six times and nothing happens, because the outcome entries need the player to also say keep/erase Brandon's name. Fix both with the same pattern scene 1C already uses: an OBSERVATION step first (a knowledge entry whose delivery_text reveals material and has a character offer the choice), then outcomes that REQUIRE the observation fact. Model every new piece on the 1C pair: storylet SL-1C-B in storylet-routes.yaml and storylets.md, knowledge entries k_sl_1c_a_r1 / k_sl_1c_b_r1 in knowledge.yaml (their requires, source, relevance, delivery_text shape), fact registry entries in storylet-routes.yaml (the `- id: captives_confirmed_alive` block with used_by_storylets), and the world.yaml fact list (the bare `- captives_confirmed_alive` line near other 1C facts).

2A CHANGES.
1. New fact `manifold_fault_found` (definition: Kristin has found the cooling-water pressure fault at the manifold), registered like captives_confirmed_alive, used_by_storylets SL-2A-B and SL-2A-C.
2. New storylet SL-2A-B "The Manifold Shows the Fault" in storylet-routes.yaml (scene 2A; activation conditions: `inspection_window_missed` equals false; pacing earliest_turn 0, target_turn 1, latest_turn 2; one realization SL-2A-B-R1 asserting manifold_fault_found; completion any_fact_true [manifold_fault_found]; abort scene_id_not 2A; a non_coercion_note like SL-1C-B) and the matching human entry in storylets.md (follow SL-1C-B's layout; place it before SL-2A-C; update the scene's storylet table row near the end of storylets.md).
3. New knowledge entry k_sl_2a_b_r1 (audience public/player_visible, available_in_scenes [2A], requires inspection_window_missed equals false, establishes assert manifold_fault_found, source storylet_realization SL-2A-B / SL-2A-B-R1). earn_when: feels the cooling lines, reads the gauge or traces the vent at the cooling manifold. action_evidence: [[feel, touch, read, trace, inspect, check, test, examine, study], [cooling manifold, manifold, cooling lines, cooling water, pressure gauge, gauge, vent, ventilation]]. delivery_text (keep close to this): Kristin feels the cooling lines, reads the gauge and traces the vent. The water pressure is falling on the return line, and the ventilation is hiding the drop. The shift supervisor says, "Well? What is failing, and what happens if nobody fixes it?"
4. SL-2A-C (storylet-routes.yaml and storylets.md "Available when") and knowledge entries k_sl_2a_c_r5 and k_sl_2a_c_r6: add the requirement manifold_fault_found equals true (storylet activation condition and knowledge `requires`). Loosen k_sl_2a_c_r5 action_evidence so an ordinary explanation matches: group 1 becomes [feel, read, trace, inspect, check, test, diagnose, explain, tell, show, say], group 2 stays, group 3 becomes [real, genuine, convincing, precise, pressure, falling, return line, masking, hiding, fail, failing, will fail]. Leave k_sl_2a_c_r6's evidence unchanged (it needs the vague/overlong words, so a plain explanation matches only r5). Do NOT change any establishes, outcome, advantage, cost, transition or the recovery storylet SL-2A-D (the missed window must still exit without the observation). Add k_sl_2a_b_r1 to incident i_2a_real_leak observation_knowledge_ids in incidents.yaml (keep r5/r6 listed).
5. The 2A entry_text in plot.md already has the supervisor saying "show me" at the manifold; do not change plot.md except where the package loader's term-trap check forces it (it rejects authored prose that uses a term owned by unavailable knowledge; if the new delivery_text or must_convey creates a trap, narrow the new entry rather than the prose).

2B CHANGES.
1. New fact `kristin_file_read` (Kristin has pulled and read her own file in the archive), registered the same way, used_by_storylets SL-2B-A and SL-2B-B.
2. New storylet SL-2B-A "Her Own File" (scene 2B; activation conditions: `audit_window_missed` equals false; pacing earliest_turn 0, target_turn 1, latest_turn 3; one realization SL-2B-A-R1 asserting kristin_file_read; completion/abort/non_coercion as above), plus its storylets.md entry before SL-2B-B and the 2B table row.
3. New knowledge entry k_sl_2b_a_r1 (public, available_in_scenes [2B], requires audit_window_missed equals false, establishes assert kristin_file_read, source SL-2B-A / SL-2B-A-R1). earn_when: pulls Kristin's own file at the archive terminals. action_evidence: [[pull, pull up, open, read, retrieve, check, examine, inspect, search, find, look up], [Kristin's file, my file, own file, personnel file, her file, own record, my record]]. delivery_text (keep close): Kristin pulls her own file. It says she was retained to lead investigators to Corfman. Kristin was bait. The build record for the system names Brandon Corfman as an author. Brandon whispers, "Let me delete my name from the record before we copy the files. Or tell me to leave it. Your call." (Do not use the word JANUS in this delivery_text: the leak guard refuses narration that mentions it before it is earned.)
4. SL-2B-B (routes and storylets.md) and knowledge entries k_sl_2b_b_r4 and k_sl_2b_b_r5: require kristin_file_read equals true. Remove the first action_evidence group (the pull/open/read verbs) and the file-noun group from BOTH r4 and r5 so only the keep/refuse vs let/erase group and the Brandon's-name group remain; keep their establishes/outcomes unchanged. Add k_sl_2b_a_r1 to incident i_2b_audit observation_knowledge_ids. SL-2B-D (recovery) and SL-2B-C stay as they are.

RIPPLE. Making the choice conditional on the observation changes tests and fixtures that walk 2A/2B. Find and update them so they assert the new behaviour (observation first, then the outcome) rather than deleting coverage: at least tests/test_2a_spine_prompts.py, tests/test_2b_spine_prompts.py, tests/test_2a_forms_words.py, tests/test_candidate_matcher.py, tests/test_design_review_fixtures.py, tests/test_evidence_penalty.py, tests/test_spine_expected_reveals.py (regenerate its expected data with scripts/generate_spine_expected_reveals.py if that is how it is produced), tests/test_stall_exit_audit.py, tests/test_incident_*.py, tests/test_act2_knowledge_sources.py, tests/test_canon_journey.py, and the 2A/2B prompt lists in frontend/e2e/canon-journey.js (the canon walk must include the observation turn: for 2A add an inspect-the-manifold turn before the diagnosis; for 2B a pull-my-own-file turn before the keep-name choice). Any player command you write in a test or journey must be imperative, first-person-possessive text per docs/player-input-guide.md (for example "Feel the cooling lines and read the gauge", "Pull my own file at the archive terminals"). Do not add new test files unless a new behaviour has no coverage; do not delete tests. Package-level invariants matter: tests that assert every storylet in storylets.md has a route entry and every fact has a registry entry must pass.

OUTPUT. Leave changes uncommitted in this worktree. Run ruff format on every Python file you touch. The harness check will run the package loader, the focused suites and ruff and export a patch; do not stop until those would pass.
tasks.check:
set -o pipefail
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp
PY=.venv/bin/python
$PY - <<'EOF' || { echo "WHY: package does not load or new ids missing"; exit 1; }
from pathlib import Path
from storygame.story_package.loader import load_story_package
p = load_story_package(Path("data/stories/continuity-initiative"))
by = {k.id: k for k in p.knowledge.knowledge}
for need in ("k_sl_2a_b_r1", "k_sl_2b_a_r1"):
    assert need in by, f"WHY: missing knowledge {need}"
def req(k): return {(r.fact_id, r.equals) for r in (by[k].requires or [])}
for k, f in (("k_sl_2a_c_r5", "manifold_fault_found"), ("k_sl_2a_c_r6", "manifold_fault_found"), ("k_sl_2b_b_r4", "kristin_file_read"), ("k_sl_2b_b_r5", "kristin_file_read")):
    assert (f, True) in req(k), f"WHY: {k} must require {f}"
print("package ok")
EOF
$PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_act2_knowledge_sources.py tests/test_act2_probe.py tests/test_2a_forms_words.py tests/test_2a_spine_prompts.py tests/test_2b_spine_prompts.py tests/test_2c_spine_prompts.py tests/test_candidate_matcher.py tests/test_design_review_fixtures.py tests/test_evidence_penalty.py tests/test_spine_expected_reveals.py tests/test_stall_exit_audit.py tests/test_incident_*.py tests/test_continuity_1c_incident.py tests/test_1c_offers.py tests/test_canon_journey.py tests/test_markdown_story_package.py tests/test_scene_2a_*.py tests/test_leak_terms*.py tests/test_knowledge_*.py 2>&1 | tail -30 || exit 1
$PY -m ruff format --check . && $PY -m ruff check . || exit 1
OUT=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/act2-visible-moves
mkdir -p $OUT && git add -A && git diff --cached > $OUT/observation.patch && wc -l $OUT/observation.patch && git diff --cached --stat | tail -3
